reckless.hl: It was **reckless** of her to trust him.
reckless.zh: 她信任他是件鲁莽的事。

hemisphere.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
hemisphere.hl: Japan is located in the Northern **Hemisphere**.

halt.en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
halt.hl: As the train came to a **halt**, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
halt.zh: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

flame.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
flame.zh: 硫磺燃烧着蓝色的火焰。

refugee.en: Refugees poured in from all over the country.
refugee.hl: **Refugees** poured in from all over the country.

bullet.en: The dog bolted away like a bullet.
bullet.hl: The dog bolted away like a **bullet**.
bullet.zh: 那只狗像子弹一样冲了出去。

collar.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
collar.hl: Iron the inside of **collars** first, and then the outside.
collar.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

couch.en: Tom is asleep on the couch.
couch.zh: 汤姆在长沙发上睡着了。

murder.en: The police are investigating the murder.
murder.zh: 警方正在调查那起谋杀案。

murder.en: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
murder.hl: The court declared him innocent on the charge of **murder**.
murder.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

ceiling.zh: 他把天花板刷成了蓝色。

ceiling.en: There's a hole in the ceiling.

hare.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
hare.hl: It is not easy to catch a **hare** with your bare hands.
hare.zh: 赤手空拳抓野兔并不容易。

roughly.en: The population of the country is roughly estimated at 50,000,000.
roughly.hl: The population of the country is **roughly** estimated at 50,000,000.
roughly.zh: 这个国家的人口粗略估计是五千万左右。

throne.en: He will succeed to the throne.
The prince succeeded to the throne.
Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
throne.hl: Prince William is second in line to the English **throne**.
throne.zh: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人。

rot.zh: 水果一般不久就会腐烂。

rot.en: This apple is starting to rot.

vague.en: She gave us a vague answer.
vague.zh: 她给了我们一个模糊的答案。

versatile.en: The programming language Java is highly versatile.
versatile.hl: The programming language Java is highly **versatile**.
versatile.zh: 编程语言 Java 用途很广。

absorb.en: I'd like to know how the body absorbs these substances.
absorb.hl: I'd like to know how the body **absorbs** these substances.
absorb.zh: 我想知道这些物质是怎么被人体吸收的。

gum.en: Some gum stuck to his shoes.
gum.zh: 口香糖粘到他的鞋子上了。

gum.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
gum.hl: There was some chewing **gum** on the sole of Tom's shoe.
gum.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

skeleton.en: Tom found a skeleton in the cave.
skeleton.hl: Tom found a **skeleton** in the cave.
skeleton.zh: 汤姆在洞穴里找到了一具骨架。

mend.en: Mend the tap in the kitchen.

porch.en: Three men are waiting for you on the porch.
porch.hl: Three men are waiting for you on the **porch**.
porch.zh: 三个男人在门廊上等你。

shiver.en: The terrible scene sent shivers down his spine.
shiver.hl: The terrible scene sent **shivers** down his spine.
shiver.zh: 恐怖的场面让他浑身发抖。

coincidence.en: It could be just a coincidence.
Maybe it was just a coincidence.

tenant.en: When the landlord's away, the tenants will play.
tenant.hl: When the landlord's away, the **tenants** will play.
tenant.zh: 当房东不在, 房客就会大玩特玩。

deteriorate.en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
deteriorate.hl: Air quality has **deteriorated** these past few years.
deteriorate.zh: 这些年空气质量恶化了。

deteriorate.en: Tom's health has been deteriorating for some time.
deteriorate.hl: Tom's health has been **deteriorating** for some time.
deteriorate.zh: 汤姆的病情这段时间一直在恶化。

tribe.en: Members of that tribe settled along the river.
tribe.hl: Members of that **tribe** settled along the river.
tribe.zh: 部落成员沿着河岸定居了。

tribe.en: Ewondo is the language spoken by the Ewondo tribe of Cameroon.
tribe.hl: Ewondo is the language spoken by the Ewondo **tribe** of Cameroon.
tribe.zh: 埃翁多语是喀麦隆埃翁多部落所说的语言。

beggar.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
beggar.zh: 这名乞丐在收集干面包。

beggar.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
beggar.hl: He is rich yet he lives like a **beggar**.
beggar.zh: 他很富有，但活得像个乞丐。

pearl.en: These pearls are genuine, not artificial.
pearl.zh: 这些珍珠是真的，不是人造的。

pearl.en: His teeth are white like a pearl.
pearl.hl: His teeth are white like a **pearl**.
pearl.zh: 他的牙齿白得像珍珠一样。

pearl.en: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
pearl.hl: The Japanese attacked **Pearl** Harbor on December 7, 1941.
pearl.zh: 日本人在一九四一年十二月七日袭击珍珠港。

jaw.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
jaw.hl: He got a broken **jaw** and lost some teeth.
jaw.zh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。

scream.en: This time, it was James who screamed.
scream.hl: This time, it was James who **screamed**.

continent.en: Africa is a very large continent.
continent.zh: 非洲是一块非常大的大陆。

continent.en: There are seven continents on the earth.
continent.hl: There are seven **continents** on the earth.

ally.en: Germany was once allied with Italy.
ally.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

barn.en: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.
barn.hl: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby **barn**.
barn.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。

barn.en: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the barn, milking the cows.
barn.hl: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the **barn**, milking the cows.
barn.zh: 他每天早上六点都会在牲口棚给母牛挤牛奶。

cricket.en: Why are there crickets in my room?
cricket.hl: Why are there **crickets** in my room?
cricket.zh: 我的房间里为什么有蟋蟀？

cricket.en: A caged cricket eats just as much as a free cricket.
cricket.hl: A caged **cricket** eats just as much as a free **cricket**.
cricket.zh: 笼子里的蟋蟀吃得跟野生的蟋蟀一样多。

duty.en: It's my duty to help you.
It was my duty to do that.
duty.hl: It was my **duty** to do that.

duty.en: He has completely lost all sense of duty.
duty.hl: He has completely lost all sense of **duty**.
